prediction: #433 lane.bf2stall433, the second draw-heavy title. The device-local vertex mirror (57fe561924) changes where every draw fetches vertex RAM, in every title. GTA San Andreas draws from guest vertex buffers too, so the change reaches it. It must not regress: the copies it adds are the vertex uploads, which are small next to the draws, and a GTA frame reads the same bytes it read before. Whether GTA gains depends on how much of its frame is GPU-bound in draws. That is not known, so no gain is predicted.
